dataset_name: NagarSetu Municipal Drainage Dataset Expansion (Phase 7 Specification)

normal_drain_controls.description: Clean roadside concrete stormwater gutters with unobstructed flow
Pre-monsoon dry municipal culverts free of silt and vegetation
Structural cast-iron and steel grating without broken bars or missing sections
Traditional stone-masonry stormwater drains in sound functional order

defect_expansions.description: Overgrowth of weeds and grass obstructing drain throat
Fine soil and mud deposits exceeding 50% capacity
Fractured concrete rim and curb inlet collapse
Open pedestrian hazard from removed drainage slabs

provenance_and_licensing_sources.license: Government Open Data / Public Municipal Inspection Archive
provenance_and_licensing_sources.attribution: Public Domain Municipal Infrastructure Imagery (India Urban Datasets)
provenance_and_licensing_sources.collection_method: Scheduled dry-season municipal infrastructure asset audit

provenance_and_licensing_sources.attribution: Open Street Media Contributors (Indian Subcontinent Infrastructure)

deduplication_and_leakage_safeguards.duplicate_hashing: Mandatory SHA-256 pre-ingestion screening against 106 existing image hashes
deduplication_and_leakage_safeguards.perceptual_hash_threshold: pHash Hamming distance <= 4 flagged for human visual inspection
deduplication_and_leakage_safeguards.split_isolation: Burst photography from the same street segment allocated as an atomic block to train, val, or test
